# Owasidea

> Owasidea is a polyglot desktop app framework. Rust, Go, TypeScript, C#, C, and
> C++ plugins compile to WASI Component Model modules described by WIT. A Rust
> Wasmtime host enforces manifests and capabilities; a Tauri 2 shell provides
> the desktop app; webview UI plugins are isolated static bundles.

## Status of 1.0 claims

- Typed TypeScript client (CT-03) is implemented: `owasidea client --lang ts`.
- UI plugin bridge (ADR-0004) is implemented and opt-in via `bridge`.
- Streaming jobs (RL-06) are experimental and require `--features streaming`.
- WebView2 is **not validated**; unsupported engines must fail closed with
  `BRIDGE_DISABLED` and keep the iframe isolated.
- Performance budgets are defined but not yet measured (G3).

## Reference commands

```bash
cargo install --path crates/cli
cd examples/shipyard
owasidea build
owasidea test
owasidea dev
owasidea bundle
```

## Invariants

- Manifests are generated from real WIT; never hand-edit them.
- Headless plugins are WASI components; `js-wasm` is webview-only.
- Permissions are deny-by-default and least-privilege.
- Tauri bundles include generated manifests, component `.wasm` files, the trust
  key and the runtime descriptor; the webview UI is embedded via `frontendDist`.
